title.narrative: UNODC Component: Cross-Regional Wildlife Programme

description.narrative: UNODC together with CITES-MIKES and CMS will implement components of the specific objectives of the cross-regional wildlife conservation programme. CITES-MIKES will be responsible for implementation of results 1.1 and 1.2 of specific objective 1 on wildlife law enforcement capacity and cross-border collaboration strengthening in selected Transboundary ecosystems. Apart from UNODC's overall coordination role, it will be responsible for the implementation of the specific objective 2 on enhancing anti-trafficking efforts. CMS is responsible for implementing result areas 3.1-3.5 for the specific objective 3 on the establishment and sustainable management of Trans-Frontier Conservation Areas (TFCAs). These actions by UNODC and partners are aimed at stopping the illegal killing and trafficking of protected wildlife species in Southern and Eastern Africa and Indian Ocean through improved management of shared ecosystems.
